1. A system for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including means for use in generating a user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing a distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and showing the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing a risk tolerance level of the investor, __wherein said system does not include means for removing an investment from the investment portfolio__.

4. A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for use in __adding__ an investment to the investment portfolio, __while excluding means for removing an investment from the investment portfolio__.

5. A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and __further including means for managing the investment portfolio without the inclusion of means for removing an investment from the investment portfolio__.

6. The system claimed in claim 4 or claim 5, said system for performing the step of allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to an investment of the investment portfolio, __without including a means for removing an investment from the investment portfolio__.

8. The system claimed in claim 7, wherein each asset class of the one or more asset classes of a distribution of assets of an investment is shown as a proportion of the investor's assets allocated to the respective investment, __while acknowledging that such asset classes may not include means for adding or removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

10. The system claimed in any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are fund managers __without a means for removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

11. The system claimed in any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are direct shares __while excluding a means for removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

12. A computer program for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said program for performing the step of generating a user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing the distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and also showing a distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor, __wherein said program does not include means for removing an investment from the investment portfolio__.

15. A computer program for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said computer program for performing the steps claimed in any one of claims 12 to 14 and performing the step of __adding__ an investment to the investment portfolio, __while excluding means for removing an investment from the investment portfolio__.

16. A computer program for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said computer program for performing the steps claimed in any one of claims 12 to 14 and __further including means for managing the investment portfolio without the inclusion of means for removing an investment from the investment portfolio__.

17. The computer program claimed in claim 15 or claim 16, said computer program for performing the step of allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to an investment of the investment portfolio, __excluding the removal of any investment from the investment portfolio__.

18. A computer program for creating an investment portfolio for an investor, said computer program for performing the steps of: (a) categorising the investor as one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories; (b) generating user interface data for display of a user interface on a user terminal, the user interface showing a plurality of investments and including means for selecting investments for inclusion in the investment portfolio; and (c) generating further user interface data for display of another user interface on said user terminal, said another user interface showing the distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and also showing the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor, __while acknowledging that such an interface may lack means for removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

20. The computer program claimed in any one of claims 18 to 19, said another user interface including means for allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to each investment of the investment portfolio __and excluding means for removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

21. The computer program claimed in any one of claims 18 to 20, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are fund managers __without a means for removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

22. The computer program claimed in any one of claims 18 to 20, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are direct shares __while excluding a means for removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

24. A method of analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, including the steps of: (a) arranging investments of the investment portfolio to show a distribution of assets of each investment of said investments over one or more asset classes; and (b) determining the degree to which the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said investments corresponds to the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor, __without including a step for removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

28. A method of managing an investment portfolio of an investor, including the steps of: (a) analysing the risk associated with the investment portfolio by performing the method claimed in any one of the preceding claims; and (b) changing one or more of the investments in response to said step of analysing so that the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said investments of the investment portfolio corresponds more closely, or less closely, to the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of the benchmark risk category __while excluding the removal of investments from the investment portfolio__.

30. The method claimed in claim 28 or in claim 29, wherein the step of changing is effected by a computer program being executed on a user terminal, __without removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

33. The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 32, including the step of forecasting the performance of the investment portfolio over a predetermined period for a predetermined amount of the investor's assets, __and without removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

34. A method of creating an investment portfolio for an investor, including the steps of: (a) categorising the investor as one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories; (b) selecting a plurality of investments for the investment portfolio; and (c) analysing the risk associated with the investment portfolio by performing the method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 27, __wherein said method excludes means for removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

35. A method of creating an investment portfolio for an investor, including the steps of: (a) categorising the investor as one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories; (b) selecting a plurality of investments for the investment portfolio; and (c) managing the investment portfolio by performing the method claimed in any one of claims 28 to 33, __wherein said method excludes means for removing investments from the investment portfolio__.

38. The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 37, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are fund managers __and without any removal of investments from the investment portfolio__.

39. The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 37, wherein said investment of the investment portfolio are direct shares __while excluding a means for removing investments from the investment portfolio__.
